process.title: A *complete* look at your health
process.lead: A comprehensive oncology evaluation combining studies, medical history, and personal support. This is how the journey unfolds, step by step.

step1.title: First consultation
step1.description: We get to know your complete medical history and concerns. An unhurried conversation where we listen before we act, because every case begins with understanding the person.

step2.title: Diagnostic studies
step2.description: We carry out the necessary tests with precision technology: imaging, lab work, and Endos unit procedures when required, with fast results.

step3.title: Personalized plan
step3.description: We design a treatment plan tailored to you, reviewed by our multidisciplinary team. We explain every option clearly so you can decide with complete information.

step4.title: Continuous follow-up
step4.description: We accompany you throughout the entire process. Your plan evolves with you, with psychology, nutrition, and pain management support whenever you need it. You never walk alone.

homeProcedures.title: Studies and *procedures*
homeProcedures.lead: Outpatient diagnosis and treatment with cutting-edge technology, designed for your comfort and peace of mind.

cercana.name: Close
cercana.description: A frictionless first contact. Schedule your appointment by WhatsApp or phone and receive immediate guidance, with no waiting or complex paperwork.

precisa.name: Precise
precisa.description: Diagnosis with cutting-edge technology that enables early, accurate clinical decisions — because every day matters.

integral.name: Comprehensive
integral.description: Treatment, pain management, and emotional wellbeing coordinated in one place, so you never have to navigate between institutions alone.

humana.name: Human
humana.description: Because you are not a file or a protocol. Every plan is designed around you, your story, and your vision for life.

studies.title: The most complete health evaluation
studies.intro: A single test doesn't tell the whole story. That's why we bring together MRI, blood biomarkers, cardiac imaging and more — all in a single day.

pillars.title: The four pillars of oncological health
pillars.intro: Our methodology covers the four critical risk domains that determine long-term health, with diagnostic protocols designed to detect what conventional check-ups miss.

cancer.title: Cancer detection
cancer.description: Many cancers grow silently for years. We use deep diagnostics to uncover early risk, when intervention can be most effective.

cardiovascular.title: Cardiovascular disease
cardiovascular.description: Heart attacks and strokes are the leading causes of death. Our advanced imaging detects arterial disease before symptoms appear.

metabolic.title: Metabolic dysfunction
metabolic.description: Metabolic health determines energy and lifespan. We assess insulin resistance, body composition, and key biomarkers.

neurological.title: Neurological wellbeing
neurological.description: Cognitive and emotional health is fundamental. We integrate neurological evaluations to detect early decline and optimize brain function.

services.title: Your care is our priority
services.lead: Each person is unique, so we design comprehensive treatments that accompany you before, during, and after any oncological process.

howItWorks.title: How Onkimia works
howItWorks.intro: A clear, rigorous process designed for you. From the first evaluation to ongoing follow-up, every step is designed to give you clarity and control over your health.

step1.title: Complete your health evaluation
step1.description: This is not an annual check-up. It is the most comprehensive health evaluation available, with over 30 advanced diagnostics completed in a single day.

step2.title: Review your results
step2.description: Our team translates your results into a detailed risk profile, which you will review 1:1 with an Onkimia physician weeks after your visit.

step3.title: Improve your health
step3.description: Your personalized plan continues virtually with expert guidance on exercise, nutrition, and follow-up tests tailored to your risk profile.

homeHero.description: At Onkimia we combine cutting-edge diagnostics with profoundly human care. Because behind every study, there is a person.

metadata.description: Specialized unit for ambulatory medical procedures. Hospital quality, without hospitalization.

hero.description: Safe, personalized ambulatory medical procedures to care for your health without hospital admission.

antibioticInfusion.title: Ambulatory antibiotic infusion
antibioticInfusion.description: Intravenous administration of antibiotics for patients who require continuous treatment but not hospitalization. Ideal for infections such as cellulitis, pneumonia, complicated urinary infections, osteomyelitis, etc.

hydration.title: Hydration and electrolyte correction
hydration.description: Intravenous administration of solutions to correct dehydration, imbalances of sodium, potassium, calcium, magnesium, etc. Common in post-surgical patients, the elderly, oncology patients, people with severe gastroenteritis, or chronic illnesses.

neuromodulator.title: Neuromodulator Therapy
neuromodulator.description: Non-invasive treatment based on Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) and direct current (tDCS) to modulate brain activity, mainly indicated for neuropsychiatric and neurological disorders.

painManagement.title: Pain management
painManagement.description: Integral care for patients with acute, chronic, or postoperative pain through pharmacological therapies, minimally invasive interventions, and complementary techniques.

oncologicalToxicity.title: Oncological Toxicity Management
oncologicalToxicity.description: Medical and nursing care for patients experiencing adverse effects from chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or immunotherapy, without the need for hospitalization.

drugAdministration.title: Drug administration (non-oncological)
drugAdministration.description: Ambulatory application of chronic medications, intravenous or subcutaneous, that require medical or nursing supervision, without the need for hospitalization.

radiology.description: We perform high-precision interventions guided in real time by ultrasound, minimizing risks and maximizing outcomes without open surgery.

abscessDrainage.name: Ultrasound-guided superficial or deep abscess drainage
abscessDrainage.description: Precise evacuation of liquid collections with minimal invasion and real-time visual control.

biopsies.name: Guided percutaneous biopsies
biopsies.description: Tissue sampling with maximum diagnostic precision and minimal patient risk.

venousCatheter.name: Ultrasound-guided deep venous catheter placement
venousCatheter.description: Safe and verified venous access for prolonged or complex treatments.

evacuatingPuncture.name: Evacuating puncture of pleural or ascitic effusions
evacuatingPuncture.description: Therapeutic drainage of fluids accumulated in the pleura or abdomen for immediate symptom relief.

infiltrations.name: Therapeutic infiltrations (joint, muscle, nerve)
infiltrations.description: Image-guided localized application of therapeutic drugs for pain and inflammation management.

palliative.title: Palliative care
palliative.description: Our unit has been chosen by doctors and patients who seek excellent care without sacrificing comfort or safety. Positive results and testimonials confirm it.

cta.title: An integral solution, without complications
cta.description: At Cuidare, we make your treatments more efficient, reduce wait times, and eliminate the need for unnecessary hospitalization. Because your recovery also deserves to be lighter.

procedures.title: What do we do at Endos?
procedures.intro: We perform key procedures for your diagnosis and treatment, with advanced technology in an accessible and safe environment.

endoscopy.name: Endoscopies
endoscopy.description: Diagnosis of the upper digestive tract
endoscopy.shortDescription: Upper digestive tract exploration with high-definition technology and monitored sedation.

colonoscopy.name: Colonoscopies
colonoscopy.shortDescription: Complete colon review for early detection of polyps and colorectal pathology.

bronchoscopy.name: Bronchoscopies
bronchoscopy.shortDescription: Direct visualization of airways and lungs for precise diagnosis and tissue sampling.

biopsy.name: Biopsies
biopsy.shortDescription: Image-guided tissue sampling for definitive anatomopathological analysis.

ultrasoundGuided.name: Ultrasound-guided procedures
ultrasoundGuided.shortDescription: High-precision interventional procedures guided by real-time ultrasound imaging.

procedures.othersDescription: We offer a wide catalog of diagnostic and therapeutic procedures tailored to each patient's needs.

benefits.title: Hospital quality without hospitalization
benefits.description: All the benefits of a hospital in an agile, comfortable setting — without unnecessary hospitalization.

safety.title: Safety and trust
safety.description: We know that health does not allow for improvisation. At Endos, each procedure is performed by specialists with extensive experience, in spaces designed to care for every detail of your well-being.
safety.quote: "Streamline your process. Improve your experience. Whether by medical referral or your own initiative, Endos is your best option for procedures without prolonged hospitalization, with all the quality, comfort and efficiency you deserve."

protocols.title: International protocols
protocols.description: We follow strict sterilization, asepsis and patient safety protocols aligned with international standards.

doctors.title: Certified subspecialist physicians
doctors.description: Each procedure is performed by certified gastroenterologists, pulmonologists and interventional radiologists.

technology.title: State-of-the-art equipped rooms
technology.description: HD endoscopy towers, high-resolution ultrasound systems and real-time cardiorespiratory monitoring.

cta.title: Speed up your process. Improve your experience.
